text: No, the 2025 loss is not confirmed as persistent. While the Hansen dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected a 13.5-hectare tree-cover loss in 2025, the corroboration rule requires confirmation from a later year in the series—which is not available (the latest observed year is 2025). The JRC 2020 reference confirms 98% of the area was forested in 2020, but no post-2025 data exists to verify if the loss persisted. Thus, the event is detected but not yet confirmed as lasting beyond 2025.
